item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently imposes a binding quantitative limit on meat that may be entered or withdrawn for consumption in 1971; the legal restriction occurs through this proclamation itself.","evidence":"is limited to 1,025.0 million pounds"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory determination and presently suspends the proclaimed import limitation for 1971, directly altering the otherwise applicable legal restriction.","evidence":"The limitation proclaimed in paragraph (1) is suspended during the calendar year 1971"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination fixing the necessary duration of the suspension, completing the legal basis and period for that suspension rather than directing a later agency outcome.","evidence":"It is hereby determined necessary that such suspension shall be for such period"}]}
